description: This file defines the FilterValidator class within the SuiteCRM project, specifically as part of the JSON API filters validators. It implements a method to validate filter field keys for the JSON API filters, checking that the input is a string and supporting some internal comment-based explanations of valid filter formats.

classes.name: FilterValidator
classes.description: A validator class for JSON API filters that checks the validity of filter field keys, ensuring they are strings and documenting valid filter syntaxes.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates whether the provided field key is a string; throws an exception if not. Otherwise, returns true, indicating the filter key is valid according to certain internal rules.
